title: Step 1 - How to Choose the Right Classification Algorithm for Your Dataset

cues.en: -: Hello my friends and welcome to the final section of part three classification where we are going to answer together a very important question.
cues.zh: 各位朋友好，歡迎來到第三部分「分類」的最後一節，我們將一起回答一個非常重要的問題。

cues.en: You know, one of the most frequently asked questions, in the data science community, which is which classification model should I select?
cues.zh: 這是資料科學界最常被問的問題之一：我應該選擇哪個分類模型？

cues.en: You know, should I choose for my dataset?
cues.zh: 也就是該替自己的資料集選哪一個？

cues.en: And the goal of this tutorial is to show you how with any dataset, you know, regardless of the number of features you have in the dataset.
cues.zh: 本堂課的目標，是示範對任何資料集，不論特徵數量有多少，

cues.en: Well, I will show you how to select quickly and efficiently the best classification model.
cues.zh: 都能快速且有效地選出最佳分類模型。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So, that's why here we are back into our Machine Learning A to Zed model selection folder.
cues.zh: 因此現在回到 Machine Learning A-Z 的模型選擇資料夾，

cues.en: You know, which is a separate folder compared to the whole Machine Learning A to Zed folder with all the codes and datasets to figure out how we're going to select the best classification model.
cues.zh: 它與包含全部程式和資料集的主資料夾分開，專門用來了解如何選擇最佳分類模型。

cues.en: All right, so here we are in the classification folder of our model selection, big folder.
cues.zh: 現在位於模型選擇大資料夾中的 classification。

cues.en: And as you can recognize in this folder we have all the classification models that we implemented together all along this part three.
cues.zh: 可以認出裡面有第三部分一起實作的全部分類模型，

cues.en: You have all of them.
cues.zh: 全部都在這裡，

cues.en: However, I slightly modified them.
cues.zh: 不過我稍微修改過。

cues.en: But the only thing I did, you know, with respect to what we did before is that I removed all the print.
cues.zh: 相較於先前內容，唯一做的事就是移除所有 print，

cues.en: You know, to alleviate or lighten the implementation so that we can see more clearly.
cues.zh: 讓實作更精簡，畫面也更清楚。

cues.en: And also of course, you know at the end I removed the two cells where we visualize the stringset and test set results. Right?
cues.zh: 另外，最後也移除了用來視覺化訓練集與測試集結果的兩個儲存格。

cues.en: Because remember these visualizations only work when you have two features.
cues.zh: 因為記得，這種視覺化只有兩個特徵時才能使用。

cues.en: And here, as you can see, I took a classic dataset with many features.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到，我採用一份有許多特徵的經典資料集，

cues.en: You can see all of them here.
cues.zh: 所有特徵都在這裡，

cues.en: So these are all the features and this is dependent variable.
cues.zh: 這些是特徵，而這個是應變數。

cues.en: But you can see this dataset as a generic dataset containing many features all with numerical values. Right?
cues.zh: 可以將它視為一般的多特徵資料集，而且特徵都是數值。

cues.en: We won't do any kind of specific data compressing and indeed a binary dependent variable taking values two or four.
cues.zh: 不需要特殊資料前處理，應變數則是二元分類，值為 2 或 4。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So since we have the dataset in front of us, well let me explain what this is about.
cues.zh: 既然資料就在面前，我還是解釋一下內容，

cues.en: Even if you know it doesn't really matter because the goal of this tutorial is just to explain how to deploy efficiently all your classification models and quickly figure out what is the best one on any dataset
cues.zh: 雖然其實並不重要，因為這堂課只是要示範如何有效套用全部分類模型，快速判斷任何資料集上表現最好的模型，

cues.en: regardless of the number of features.
cues.zh: 不受特徵數量限制。

cues.en: But let me still explain what this is about.
cues.zh: 但還是介紹一下，

cues.en: So this is a classic dataset which belongs to the UCIML Machinery Repository and which is about breast cancer.
cues.zh: 這是 UCI Machine Learning Repository 的經典乳癌資料集。

cues.en: So in this dataset, each row corresponds to a patient.
cues.zh: 每一列代表一位病人，

cues.en: You know, different patients here.
cues.zh: 這裡是不同病人。

cues.en: And for each of these patients, we gathered, well first a sample code number, the clump thickness, the uniformity of cell size,
cues.zh: 每位病人都有樣本編號、腫塊厚度、細胞大小均一性、

cues.en: the uniformity of cell shape the marginal adhesion, the single epithelial cell the bare nuclei, the bland chromatin,
cues.zh: 細胞形狀均一性、邊緣黏附性、單一上皮細胞大小、裸核、染色質，

cues.en: the normal nucleoli and the mitoses.
cues.zh: 正常核仁，以及有絲分裂等資料。

cues.en: Okay? And all these variables are the features, you know from sample code number, even if that's not really the feature up to mitoses.
cues.zh: 這些變數都是特徵，從 sample code number 到 mitoses，雖然樣本編號其實不算真正的特徵。

cues.en: And with all these features we are predicting the class, which tells for each patient if the tumor is benign.
cues.zh: 使用所有特徵預測 class，表示每位病人的腫瘤是否為良性，

cues.en: In which case, class takes the value of two.
cues.zh: 若為良性，class 的值是 2，

cues.en: Or malignant in which case class takes the value of four.
cues.zh: 若為惡性，class 的值是 4。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So that's what the dataset is about.
cues.zh: 這就是資料集的內容。

cues.en: You can find it on the UCIML repository by the name breast cancer.
cues.zh: 可以在 UCI ML Repository 以 breast cancer 名稱找到，

cues.en: And you can take the original version.
cues.zh: 也能取得原始版本。

cues.en: But really, don't worry about all these features because you know most of us don't understand what they mean.
cues.zh: 但不必擔心這些特徵，因為大多數人並不理解它們的意思。

cues.en: You know, we're not doctors here but we are data scientists.
cues.zh: 我們不是醫師，而是資料科學家，

cues.en: And even if we don't understand the main knowledge here of oncology, you know, cancer medicine, well that's still fine because we can still build classification models
cues.zh: 即使不具備腫瘤學，也就是癌症醫學的領域知識，仍然沒關係，因為仍可建立分類模型，

cues.en: to understand the correlations between all these features here and the dependent variable class.
cues.zh: 了解各個特徵與應變數 class 之間的關聯，

cues.en: Which we want to predict telling if the tumor of each of these patients is benign or malignant.
cues.zh: 用來預測每位病人的腫瘤是良性還是惡性。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: And so we're gonna use this dataset to deploy all our classification models in a flashlight, you know, in a matter of seconds.
cues.zh: 所以會用這份資料集，快速套用全部分類模型，只需要幾秒鐘，

cues.en: And after just a few clicks, we will be able to figure out what is the best classification model for this dataset.
cues.zh: 點幾下就能判斷哪個分類模型最適合這份資料集。

cues.en: All right? Great.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So let's do this.
cues.zh: 我們開始吧，

cues.en: Let's close this.
cues.zh: 先關閉這個。

cues.en: And now, now what we're going to do in order to start the demo is because you know this is a Google Drive folder to which all of you have access and therefore you can't modify it obviously.
cues.zh: 為了開始示範，現在要做的是：這是所有人都能存取的 Google Drive 資料夾，所以顯然不能修改原檔。

cues.en: And so what you have to do in order to modify these cells, you know, because we will have to enter the name of the dataset because these are all code templates.
cues.zh: 而為了修改儲存格，因為這些都是程式範本，我們需要填入資料集名稱，

cues.en: In order to modify these cells you need to create a copy.
cues.zh: 因此必須先建立副本。

cues.en: So that's the first thing we'll do here.
cues.zh: 這就是這裡的第一步，

cues.en: Let's do this quickly.
cues.zh: 很快做一下，

cues.en: You know, you just need to do a right click and then make a copy for each of them.
cues.zh: 只需按右鍵，對每份檔案選擇建立副本。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: Then kernel SVM, make a copy logistic regression.
cues.zh: 接著是 Kernel SVM，建立副本，再來邏輯斯迴歸，

cues.en: So you see it's pretty fast, sorry about that.
cues.zh: 你看速度很快，抱歉動作有點快，

cues.en: But at least it only takes a few seconds.
cues.zh: 但這至少只需要幾秒。

cues.en: And then you'll get all your copies, in case you know you want to modify them.
cues.zh: 接著就有自己的副本，如果想修改，

cues.en: But I recommend to.
cues.zh: 而我也建議修改。

cues.en: All right, then your copies would go naturally to your main drive or you know, in the Colab notebooks folder.
cues.zh: 副本通常會放到你的雲端硬碟，或者 Colab Notebooks 資料夾，

cues.en: Here they just went into my drive.
cues.zh: 我這裡直接放到我的雲端硬碟，

cues.en: So all good.
cues.zh: 所以沒問題。

cues.en: Now we're gonna open them all.
cues.zh: 現在把它們全部打開，

cues.en: So starting with the last one, random forest.
cues.zh: 從最後一個隨機森林開始，

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: Then we're gonna open decision tree classification.
cues.zh: 接著開啟決策樹分類，

cues.en: Open, right?
cues.zh: 開啟，對吧？

cues.en: You can open it with Jupyter Notebook also if you want.
cues.zh: 你想的話也能用 Jupyter Notebook 開啟。

cues.en: Right? Then we're gonna open knife bays.
cues.zh: 接著開啟 Naive Bayes，

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: Then we're gonna open Kernel SVM.
cues.zh: 然後開啟 Kernel SVM，

cues.en: Perfect. Then we're gonna open SVM.
cues.zh: 很好，再開啟 SVM，

cues.en: Where is it?
cues.zh: 在哪裡？

cues.en: Right here?
cues.zh: 就在這裡，

cues.en: Support vector machine open.
cues.zh: 開啟支援向量機，

cues.en: Then we're going to open the K-nearest neighbor.
cues.zh: 再開啟 K 最近鄰，

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好，

cues.en: And finally we're gonna open logistic regression.
cues.zh: 最後開啟邏輯斯迴歸。

cues.en: I went from the last to the first because as you can see this is the way now we have all the files in the correct order.
cues.zh: 我由最後往前開，是因為這樣所有檔案就會按照正確順序排列。
